messages.subject: distsamp dist.breaks question
parts:
I have a unmarkedFrameDS object that has some issue with the distance
breaks I am using. When I run the distsamp function it gives me an
error.


I am trying to run a null model to get the distsamp function running
before I add site covariates.
Here is what I have:

sppid<-data.frame(transect=sppi$TransectNum,distance=sppi
$radialDistance)

cp <- c(12,62,76,88,94,114,141,245)

yDat <- formatDistData(sppid, "distance", "transect",cp)

sppiptUMF<- with(yDat, {unmarkedFrameDS(y = cbind(y.1,y.2,y.3,y.4,y.
5,y.6,y.7),
dist.breaks = c(0,62,76,88,94,114,141,245), survey = "point", unitsIn
= "m")
})

sp1 <- distsamp(~ 1, ~ 1,
sppiptUMF,keyfun="halfnorm",output="density",unitsOut="kmsq")

Error in distsamp(~1, ~1, sppiptUMF, keyfun = "halfnorm", output =
"density", :
trying to get slot "dist.breaks" from an object (class "formula")
that is not an S4 object

Seems like there is an easy solution but I can't figure it out.

Rob Sparks

messages.author: 9548b9e0c8258268
messages.subject: Re: distsamp dist.breaks question
parts:
Hi Rob,

It looks like the problem is that you've got 2 formulas (~1, ~1) when
you should have only one (~ 1 ~ 1). See ?distsamp for details.

Hope that helps,
Ian
